console-cleared.notes: Reviewed: Clear leaves an empty console. The harness starts hidden, so Popup on error is off; the engine's deterministic Global LOS state is shown on.

console-hidden.notes: Reviewed: F8 removes the native console while leaving the map unobscured.

console-problems-off.notes: Reviewed: the Problems button returns to its unpressed state after the second click.

console-problems-on.notes: Reviewed: the Problems button is visibly pressed after its correctly targeted toolbar click.

console-shown.notes: Reviewed: F8 reopens the native console with its evenly sized, legible toolbar.
